text:
Which method does not demagnetise a bar magnet?
A
Heat the bar magnet and place it in the east-west direction to cool.
B
Place the bar magnet in the east-west direction and hammer it.
C
Place the bar magnet in a coil connected to an a.c. supply and slowly withdraw it.
D
Place the bar magnet in a coil connected to a d.c. supply and slowly withdraw it.

options.label: A
options.text: Heat the bar magnet and place it in the east-west direction to cool.
